title: 3+1D Spinless point groups: without independent E8 decoration
scope: The computed column contains the retained CI, charge and group-cohomological phase model. Each real-space source version has its own reference column. For improper groups those columns are explicitly source-side quotients by independently identified neutral E8 roots; equality of invariant factors is not a verified physical quotient map. E8-inclusive comparison is deferred. No missing E8 operation is assigned zero. The 2+1D uniform n0 and e0 coordinates do not label these 3+1D tables.
row_rule: One group per row; one dimension, family, physical spin and n0 scope per file

Debray.title: Invertible phases for mixed spatial symmetries and the fermionic crystalline equivalence principle
Debray.method: Spin-c/Pin-c bordism, Adams spectral sequences, Anderson-dual equivariant phase homology
Debray.location: Tables 1–6 and theorems specified separately in each row; extracted Class A phase groups
Debray.author: Arun Debray
Debray.scope: Interacting Class A only, under the generalized-homology ansatz. Class D columns are not extracted. Includes independent intrinsic responses and neutral bosonic contributions.
Debray.independence_limit: Different mathematical method; v3 explicitly acknowledges revisions following comparison with Zhang-Ning-Qi-Gu2025. Not blind independence of the final tables.

NMLW.authors: Shang-Qiang Ning, Bin-Bin Mao, Zhengqiao Li, Chenjie Wang
NMLW.title: Anomaly indicators and bulk-boundary correspondences for 3D interacting topological crystalline phases with mirror and continuous symmetries
NMLW.method: Interacting dimensional reduction, folding, and complete bulk anomaly indicators for the stated symmetry.
NMLW.independence_limit: Distinct physical detectors, but the mirror classification builds on Song-Huang-Fu-Hermele2017; not blind independence.
NMLW.location: Table II; Sec.III.B.1 Eqs.19-20 pp.12-13; AppendixB.1 Eq.B4 p.31
